title: Bind chat session validation to the enrolled device
spec: Add Sessions::validate_for(token, user, device, now_ms). Reject unknown tokens and any mismatch with the user and device resolved from the verified client certificate. Leave the owner's entry untouched on a mismatch. A matching live token refreshes its idle timestamp as before. A matching expired or revoked token is refused. Preserve the existing validate and token storage behavior.
